items.meta_description: VpnHood! – A free, secure, and open-source VPN with a global server network designed to protect your online privacy and ensure secure access to the web.
items.page_desc: empowers users to create and manage their own VPN servers with ease, offering a free and open-source solution.
items.manager_desc: VpnHood! MANAGER is a web-based dashboard that allows users to set up, configure, and monitor their VPN servers effortlessly. With an intuitive interface, users can:
items.manager_li_deploy: Deploy and manage VPN servers without technical expertise.
items.manager_li_monitor: Monitor connection logs and performance metrics.
items.manager_li_api: Utilize a RESTful API for advanced automation.
items.client_desc: VpnHood! CLIENT is available for Windows and Android, providing a seamless VPN experience for users. Key features include:
items.client_li_fast: Fast and secure VPN connections powered by VpnHood Engine.
items.client_li_protocol: Steadfast protocol to ensures a smooth, encrypted connection, maintaining a private online presence across various network environments.
items.client_li_split: Split tunneling for apps, IPs, domains, and country-based filtering.
items.outro: With VpnHood, users can enjoy a self-hosted VPN solution that is free, customizable, and easy to manage.
